"10. Advertising\nThe free version shows Google AdMob ads on the Home and Tools screens and after some tools finish; never inside the reader or the editors. Where the law requires it (e.g. EU and UK) we ask for your consent first through Google\'s consent form; you can change it under “Ad privacy options”. AdMob may use the advertising ID, device information and approximate location to serve and measure ads under Google\'s privacy policy. Your documents are never sent to any ad network. Pro subscribers see no ads."

"11. Purchase and licence verification\nWhen the licence server is enabled, the Google Play purchase token or the activation code is sent with an anonymous device fingerprint (derived, not the device identifier itself) to our server for verification; the server returns a signed licence stored on your device. We keep a record of codes and activated devices only to prevent abuse. The licence is re-checked every few days when you are online."
